cuts.title: Marlon swore he could pet a lion, then it roared
cuts.hook: Marlon says he could pet a lion
cuts.retelling: Marlon says he could walk up and pet a lion on a night safari, then spends the next minutes telling it to calm down. It roars about ten times and he claims he calmed it, then names it Gigu.
